metadata.title: Exporting Regrid Data to ArcGIS - Regrid Property App (Web)
metadata.author: Regrid
metadata.shortDescription:
Exporting data as a shapefile (.SHP) from the Regrid platform, then importing it into ArcGIS Pro.

The Regrid Property App is great if you want to see and work with property data using the tools we provide. If you are an Esri user and like our data (and especially if you have complex workfllows), you may be interested in our Feature Service product, which "streams" our property data directly into Esri platforms: https://regrid.com/feature-service

Please note that the Regrid Property App interface has been updated since this video was shot - while the UI is slightly different now, the functionality remains the same.
